hero.title: Hi, I'm Facundo Gandolfo
hero.subtitle: Full-Stack Developer & Tech Lead
hero.paragraph: I design and build web applications end to end with React, TypeScript and Spring Boot. Today I lead the team replacing Modica Seguros' policy management system, and I work with clients in Argentina and abroad turning ideas into real products.

services.title: Services
services.description: If you have a business or an idea, I'll help you take it to production: from the Figma design to deployment and maintenance.

items.title: Websites & landing pages
items.description: Company sites, landing pages and stores that are fast, responsive and ready to rank on Google.

items.title: Internal systems & dashboards
items.description: I replace Excel spreadsheets with web apps featuring roles, reports and data import/export.

items.title: Desktop & mobile apps
items.description: Custom apps to manage orders, stock or customers, connected to your own database.

items.title: UI design in Figma
items.description: Clean, well-organized prototypes and designs, ready to validate with your users or hand off to development.

items.title: Maintenance & improvements
items.description: Support, new features and refactors so your product keeps growing without breaking.

roles.title: Full-Stack Developer & Tech Lead
bullets: Lead the development of the internal application (React, TypeScript, Spring Boot, MySQL) that replaces the Excel-based policy management, including an admin dashboard.
Coordinate a team of interns with GitHub Projects, run regular code reviews and guide technical decisions.
Restructured the backend into a package-by-feature architecture, reducing the learning curve for new developers.
Implemented Excel ↔ system import and export (SheetJS and Apache POI) and created the team's training material.
Built the informational website for clients, with an assistant and direct contact with the office.

roles.title: Designer & Community Manager
bullets: Design logos and posts in Figma and manage the company's Instagram and LinkedIn.

roles.title: Front-End Team Lead · Internship
bullets: Built a corporate web application as a team, leading the front-end: coordinating tasks and delegating responsibilities.
Worked with the backend and database teams to align the solution with project requirements.

roles.title: Freelance Developer & Designer
bullets: Build web, desktop and mobile applications for clients in Argentina, Spain, Portugal and the United States.
Manage each project end to end: requirements, scope, Figma design, implementation and maintenance, within agreed deadlines and budgets.

clients.title: Client work
clients.description: Some real projects I built for businesses: what they needed, what I built and what changed.

items.problem: All policy management lived in Excel spreadsheets that were hard to maintain and share.
items.solution: A web application with an admin dashboard, roles and Excel import/export, plus an informational website for their clients.
items.result: Operations are centralized in a single system, and I now lead the project with a team of interns.

items.problem: An industrial textile solutions company needed a professional online presence, fast.
items.solution: Design and development of a company landing page focused on showcasing their products and generating leads.
items.result: Delivered in 2 days. The client came back to order their online store.

items.problem: After the landing page, they needed to sell online the workwear they manufacture for YPF service stations.
items.solution: An online store built with Astro, with a categorized catalog, prices and a shopping cart.
items.result: Returning client: from a landing page to their own sales platform.

items.problem: Orders and deliveries were tracked by hand, with no way to measure sales.
items.solution: A desktop app for the store and a mobile app for deliveries, with a statistics module.
items.result: Orders and deliveries organized in a single system, with data to make decisions.

aboutMe.paragraph1: I'm a Programming Technician and full-stack developer. I started as an intern at Modica Seguros and today I'm the technical lead of the team building their internal system, while I keep working with my own clients as a freelancer.
aboutMe.paragraph2: I care about both the code and the product: how to structure a backend so a new team understands it quickly, how an interface looks in Figma before writing a single line, and how to explain a technical decision to someone who isn't technical.
aboutMe.paragraph3: I'm currently taking ITBA's Full Stack Developer program on a Santander Open Academy scholarship. I'm looking for projects and teams where I can keep growing and deliver real value.
